subject: Re: JAX-DFT kickoff — differentiable DFT for materials screening
body: Status. Physics repro: done — training the neural XC functional with the Kohn-Sham equations in the loop reproduces the headline result: from two H2 separations we recover the full dissociation curve within chemical accuracy, strongly correlated region included, and the same model transfers to our held-out 1D molecules without refitting. Training the same functional without the KS solver in the loop (plain loss-term supervision) fails exactly as the paper says — a good sanity check that the implicit-regularization story is what we're productizing. Harness: API draft circulated; Paloma's ramp starts June 1 per the staffing plan. Risks: (1) the collaboration wants 3D eventually — we should be explicit at the go/no-go that this codebase is 1D building blocks and the value is the differentiable-program pattern; (2) Linnea's persistent compilation cache cut cold compiles to 90 s, but it breaks on JAX upgrades, so we pin versions for the demo. — Kaia
